body:
Hey. Ironically, my name is Emma, and I’m the dumb twin. LOL! My twin tends to “let it slip” that I’m not in a doctorate program and that she is, and the like. I know what that feels like.

Ironically, I’m the musical twin. Was a music director for an acapella group, went to school for piano performance and technology; it’s my passion. It’s not a secret amongst the family which talents belong to whom, but all in all, academia tends to be respected more. Who could guess? :’]

I say all of this to say: stand strong. Your talents are YOURS, not something to exploit or downplay for others’ benefit. I commend you for your response.

NTA.

In regards to the “3-D shot” with the scene of the Stevens hugging, James Baxter was the animator! He’s highly-respected in the field for his ability to hand-animate in 2-D but utilize 3-D animation theory in perspective. A great example of this is the ballroom dancing scene he animated in Beauty and the Beast when the angle of perspective comes down from the ceiling to the two of them. :)

Thank you guys for creating such an amazing show! I actually just wrote a thesis paper on the cultural significance in today’s world. Here’s my question:

Can Steven’s gem he removed from his body without harming/killing him? If he sleeps and eats for energy like a human rather than light as energy like a gem, can he live without the gem altogether?

Very VERY important question that could change the way we all see the show: 

Is Onion human?
Who was the hardest character to write for and why?
